title: Move readiness badges from team list to selected-team panel
objective: Keep the primary team list visually minimal while preserving readiness information after a team has been selected.
changes: Removed all four readiness badges from every team card in the team-selection list.
Added a compact selected-team status panel immediately before the player-selection step.
The selected-team panel shows probability, EV, market and ROI readiness for only the currently selected team.
Kept the active-team highlight in the list so users can still see which team is selected.
Reduced team-list gap, card height and bottom spacing for faster scanning.
guarantees: Team cards contain no readiness-status badges.
Readiness information remains available after team selection.
Matched-player previews remain available only when a player search makes them relevant.
Team selection, player selection, EV logic and market-readiness calculations are unchanged.
